entities.summary: Masahiko Kageyama is a former racing driver from Japan. He participated in the Japanese Grand Touring Car series in the top category between 1993 and 2002. Masahiko Kageyama was a architects & engineers from Fujisawa (b. 1968-08-08, Fujisawa). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
